issue.title: bob plugins sync refuses clean deploy stamps with an unknown source_head even when an ancestor commit holds the bundle byte for byte
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-o6.6.1.5 note #3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); triaged and reproduced by the bob-cli-o6.6.1 land agent on 2026-11-21.

Root cause: in `evaluate_guard`, the `PriorStamp::Complete { matches_vault: true }` arm for a stamp with `dirty == DirtyState::Clean` only permits when `ancestor_of(incoming_repo, stamp.source_head)` is `Yes`. It never calls `find_inclusion_proof`, which the dirty-stamp arm already uses. So when a clean deploy came from a commit that was later rebased, amended, or never pushed, its `source_head` is unknown to every other checkout and every sync refuses, even when an ancestor commit holds the deployed bundle byte for byte. bob-plugins `docs/develop/deployment.md` promises the opposite: "Any clean checkout whose HEAD reaches a commit holding the deployed bundle byte for byte syncs without `--force`."

Repro on athena, bob-plugins master e6d7aed (clean):
1. `~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/{block-id-prompt,task-status-cycler}/.bob-deploy.json` record `dirty: clean`, `source_head` 726f9a5c65, source_root bob-cli_13's linked bob-plugins, deployed 2026-11-21T13:11:53Z. `git cat-file -t 726f9a5c65` in the master checkout: not a valid object.
2. The vault's manifest.json, main.js, and styles.css are byte-identical to the trees of ancestor commits 3956368 (block-id-prompt 1.39.0) and 6e0d764 (task-status-cycler 1.52.0). Both are ancestors of HEAD (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`).
3. `bob plugins sync -n -r . --dry-run -p block-id-prompt` refuses: "incoming HEAD does not contain the stamped clean revision". Same for task-status-cycler.

Fix direction: in the clean-stamp arm, when `ancestor_of` is not `Yes` and the incoming checkout is clean, try `find_inclusion_proof` and permit with `proving_commit` on a hit, exactly as the dirty arm does. Keep refusing when no single reachable commit holds the whole stamped bundle. Add unit coverage next to the existing dirty-stamp inclusion-proof tests, plus a CLI test for a clean stamp with an unknown source_head.

This is distinct from bob-cli-mv. That bug covers dirty stamps after a rebase, where no byte-identical commit exists at all. Here a byte-identical commit does exist, and only the clean-stamp branch skips the proof.

evidence.note: Independent reports from epic bob-cli-on.10.1: phases bob-cli-on.10.1.1 (note #2) and bob-cli-on.10.1.2 (note #1) hit the same refusal — the vault's task-status-cycler and block-id-prompt stamps were clean at 726f9a5 (a rebased-away commit) while the deployed bytes sat in landed history (cycler 1.52.0 main.js in 6e0d764, BIP 1.39.0 main.js in 3956368); deploy.rs applied find_inclusion_proof only to dirty stamps, so the documented Landed recipe refused and cycler 1.53.0/1.54.0 and BIP 1.41.0 stayed undeployed for hours.
